searchKnowledge.label: Knowledge retrieval
searchKnowledge.description: Retrieve relevant segments from knowledge bases
searchKnowledge.directAnswerContent: Segment content eligible for direct answers

searchMode.label: Search settings
searchMode.autoDescription: Automatically match document tags based on the search question

reranker.label: Multi-source Rerank
reranker.description: Rerank retrieval results from multiple knowledge bases

score.label: Score higher than
score.description: The higher the score, the stronger the relevance.

documentSplit.label: Document segmentation
documentSplit.description: Split input document content into a list of segments using the segmentation strategy

childChunkLength.label: Sub-chunk length
childChunkLength.description: Balance retrieval accuracy and recall efficiency
childChunkLength.tooShortHint: Avoid overly short chunks: fewer than 50 characters can fragment meaning and leave too little context to match the query intent
childChunkLength.tooLongHint: Avoid overly long chunks: more than 500 characters can add redundant information, reduce retrieval accuracy, and require more storage and computing resources

documentSplit.titleAsQuestion: Use the segment title as a related question for the segment
documentSplit.documentNameAsQuestion: Use the document name as a related question for the segment

localFile.label: Local files
localFile.description: Upload local documents and output a document list. Use the Document content extraction node to parse their contents

fileCount.label: Maximum files per upload
fileCount.rangeMessage: Enter a file count from {min} to {max}

fileSize.label: Maximum size per file
fileSize.rangeMessage: Enter a file size from {min} to {max} MB

webSource.label: Web site
webSource.description: Crawl web data from a root URL and output documents with content, with one document per URL

knowledgeWrite.label: Write to knowledge
knowledgeWrite.description: Write the input segments to the current knowledge and generate embeddings
